seo.title: Super Universe — Interactive 3D Universe Map
seo.description: Explore the Solar System, stars, exoplanets, the Milky Way and the cosmic web in a fluid, scientific and interactive 3D map.
seo.socialDescription: Explore the Solar System, stars, exoplanets, the Milky Way and the cosmic web in an interactive scientific 3D map.
seo.imageAlt: 3D view of the Milky Way in Super Universe
seo.heading: Super Universe, an interactive 3D map of the Universe
features: Continuous navigation from the Solar System to the cosmic web
Astronomical positions calculated for the selected date
Documented stars, exoplanets, galaxies, eclipses and cosmic structures

shell.navigationHint: Hover over a label, then click to center it · Use the wheel to zoom

shell.cosmicProgressiveNote: Progressive display · zoom in to reveal individual detections

shell.scienceNearby: 720 observed galaxies ≤ 11 Mpc · 37,730 calculated Cosmicflows-4 groups · illustrative shapes and luminosities
shell.scienceLocalGroup: 31 documented Local Group galaxies · calculated Cosmicflows-4 directions · adapted depths and luminosities
shell.scienceDefault: Adapted visual distances and sizes · local static data

mapScale.title: Distance across the target plane; representations remain adapted to the zoom level

details.noDescription: No description is available for this object.
details.catalogDescription: Scientific object documented by {source}. Its confidence level and main measurements are detailed below.
details.illustrativeAppearance: Scientific appearance adapted for visualization; textures, colors or relief may combine observations and illustrative processes.
details.historicalAppearanceNote: The position and epoch come from historical or instrumental observations. The displayed light curve, colors and expansion are illustrative.
details.approximationNote: This view is an approximate reconstruction. The position or appearance may be extrapolated or simulated.
details.receivedLightClampedNote: The emission epoch exceeds the ±10,000-year HYG domain; the position is clamped to the documented model boundary.
details.receivedLightComovingCosmologyNote: Extrapolated: redshift is inferred from the catalogue comoving distance with the documented flat ΛCDM model. The 3D position stays static.
details.receivedLightLuminosityCosmologyNote: Extrapolated: redshift is inferred from the catalogue luminosity distance with the documented flat ΛCDM model. The 3D position stays static.
details.orbitCatalogNote: Confirmed planet. The period and semi-major axis come from the catalog; the phase, orientation and orbital scale are illustrative.
details.orbitCalculatedNote: Confirmed planet. A missing orbital parameter is calculated using Kepler’s third law; the phase, orientation and scale remain illustrative.
details.orbitOneIllustrativeNote: Confirmed planet. One missing orbital parameter uses an illustrative value; the phase, orientation and scale are illustrative too.
details.orbitIllustrativeNote: Confirmed planet. Because no parameters are published, the spacing and period are illustrative; the phase, orientation and scale are illustrative too.
details.mapDistanceNote: The sky direction is observed, but no distance has been published. An illustrative depth of {depth} pc temporarily places this system on the map.
details.confidenceObservedDescription: Based on measurements or an astronomical catalog.
details.confidenceCalculatedDescription: Position or distance obtained through a documented scientific calculation.
details.confidenceSimulatedDescription: Result produced by a scientific model.
details.confidenceProceduralDescription: Content generated to complete the scene.
details.confidenceIllustrativeDescription: Visual representation that does not preserve the real scale.
details.fullOrbitTitle: Show the full orbit around the parent body
details.historicalEventTitle: Show the historical epoch; the light curve remains illustrative
